title: Speicheranlage mit optimierter Wärmezufuhr
docs.abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine Speicheranlage zum Speichern thermischer Energie mit einem Ladekreislauf, welcher in unmittelbarer oder mittelbarer Abfolge einen Verdampfer und einen Verdichter und einen mit einem Wärmespeicher gekoppelten Lade-Wärmetauscher und eine Drossel umfasst. Der Verdampfer ist zur Wärmeaufnahme mit einem Kaltspeicher oder einer externen Wärmequelle gekoppelt.

title: Speicheranlage mit optimierter Wärmenutzung
docs.abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine Speicheranlage zum Speichern thermischer Energie mit einem Ladekreislauf, welcher in unmittelbarer oder mittelbarer Abfolge einen Verdampfer und einen Verdichter und einen mit einem Wärmespeicher gekoppelten Lade-Wärmetauscher und eine Drossel umfasst. title: Speicheranlage mit optimierter Wärmezufuhr
docs.abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine Speicheranlage zum Speichern thermischer Energie mit einem Ladekreislauf, welcher in unmittelbarer oder mittelbarer Abfolge einen Verdampfer und einen Verdichter und einen mit einem Wärmespeicher gekoppelten Lade-Wärmetauscher und eine Drossel umfasst. Zur Rückgewinnung der im Wärmespeicher gespeicherten Energie wird ein Entladekreislauf verwendet. Dabei umfasst der Entladekreislauf in unmittelbarer oder mittelbarer Abfolge eine Pumpe und einen Entlade-Wärmetauscher und eine Dampfturbine und einen Kondensator. Zur Rückgewinnung der Wärmeenergie wird hierzu der Entlade-Wärmetauscher mit dem Wärmespeicher gekoppelt. Zur Optimierung der Wärmenutzung werden sowohl der Verdampfer als auch der Kondensator mit einem gemeinsamen Kaltspeicher gekoppelt.

title: Speicheranlage mit Prozessdampf-Versorgung
docs.abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine Speicheranlage zum Speichern thermischer Energie mit einem Ladekreislauf, welcher in unmittelbarer oder mittelbarer Abfolge einen Verdampfer und einen Verdichter und einen mit einem Wärmespeicher gekoppelten Lade-Wärmetauscher und eine Drossel umfasst. Weiterhin bedarf es einer Prozessdampfleitung, welche geeignet ist, externe Anlagen mit Prozessdampf zu versorgen. Dabei weist der Ladekreislauf weiterhin in unmittelbarer oder mittelbarer Abfolge zwischen dem Lade-Wärmetauscher und der Drossel eine Entnahmedrossel und einen Separator auf, wobei der Separator direkt oder indirekt über einen Prozessdampf-Wärmetauscher mit der Prozessdampfleitung verbunden ist.

title: PUMPED HEAT ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEM INTEGRATED WITH COAL-FIRED ENERGY GENERATION UNIT
docs.abstract: The present disclosure provides pumped heat energy storage systems that can be integrated with a Coal Fired Energy Generation Unit (CF-EGU) to repurpose CF-EGUs as thermal energy storage systems. A pumped heat energy storage system of the present disclosure can store thermal energy by operating as a heat pump with heat discharge occurring as a result of heat engine operation of the pumped heat energy storage system and/or a steam cycle of the CF-EGUs to provide heating thereto. For example, thermal energy can be exchanged via working fluids flowing between the pumped heat energy storage systems and the CF-EGUs to drive turbines that provide power to generators while repurposing equipment from the CF-EGUs to create energy.

title: PUMPED HEAT ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEM WITH LOAD FOLLOWING
docs.abstract: A method including: (i) receiving a first amount of electricity into a pumped-heat energy storage system ("PHES system") from a power generation plant supplying a second amount of electricity to an electrical grid; (ii) operating the PHES system in a charge mode, converting at least a portion of the received first amount of electricity to stored thermal energy; and (iii) increasing a power level of the PHES system such that the first amount of electricity that the PHES system receives from the power generation plant is increased such that the second amount of electricity supplied to the electrical grid by the power generation plant is a reduced amount of electricity less than the second amount of electricity.

title: PUMPED HEAT ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEM WITH LOAD FOLLOWING
docs.abstract: A method including: operating a pumped-heat energy storage (“PHES”) system in a generation mode to generate electricity; and responsive, at least in part, to a determination that a power generation plant will reduce supply of electricity to an electrical grid by a reduction amount of electricity, changing modes of the PHES system from the generation mode to operate in a charge mode. Operating in the charge mode can include receiving a charge amount of electricity, at least equal to the reduction amount of electricity, into the PHES system from the power generation plant and converting at least a portion of the charge amount of electricity to stored thermal energy.

title: Pumped heat energy storage system with load following
docs.abstract: Un método que incluye: (i) recibir una primera cantidad de electricidad en un sistema de almacenamiento de energía de calor bombeado ("sistema PHES") desde una planta de generación de energía que suministra una segunda cantidad de electricidad a una red eléctrica; (ii) operar el sistema PHES en un modo de carga, convirtiendo al menos una parte de la primera cantidad de electricidad recibida en energía térmica almacenada; y (iii) aumentar el nivel de potencia del sistema PHES de manera que la primera cantidad de electricidad que el sistema PHES recibe de la planta de generación de energía aumente de manera que la segunda cantidad de electricidad suministrada a la red eléctrica por la planta de generación de energía sea una cantidad reducida de electricidad menos que la segunda cantidad de electricidad.

title: SISTEMA DE ARMAZENAMENTO DE ENERGIA TÉRMICA BOMBEADA COM SEGUIDOR DE CARGA
docs.abstract: SISTEMA DE ARMAZENAMENTO DE ENERGIA TÉRMICA BOMBEADA COM SEGUIDOR DE CARGA. A presente invenção refere-se a método que inclui: (i) receber uma primeira quantidade de eletricidade em um sistema de armazenamento de energia térmica bombeada ("sistema PHES") a partir de uma usina de geração de energia que alimenta uma segunda quantidade de eletricidade a uma rede elétrica; (ii) operar o sistema PHES em um modo de carregamento ao converter pelo menos uma parte da primeira quantidade de eletricidade recebida em energia térmica armazenada; e (iii) aumentar o nível de energia do sistema PHES de modo que a primeira quantidade de eletricidade que o sistema PHES recebe a partir da usina de geração de energia seja aumentada para que a segunda quantidade de eletricidade fornecida à rede elétrica pela usina de geração de energia seja uma quantidade reduzida de eletricidade menor do que a segunda quantidade de eletricidade.

title: Speicheranlage mit Mehrfachzirkulation
docs.abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine Speicheranlage zum Speichern thermischer Energie mit einem Ladekreislauf, welcher in unmittelbarer oder mittelbarer Abfolge einen Verdampfer und einen Verdichter und einen mit einem Wärmespeicher gekoppelten Lade-Wärmetauscher und eine Drossel umfasst. Zur Effizienzsteigerung ist zunächst vorgesehen, dass die Verdichtung und Wärmeübertragung mehrstufig erfolgt. D.h. es ist mehrfach eine Anordnung aus Verdichter und Lade-Wärmetauscher mit nachfolgendem Leitungsabschnitt vorhanden. Erfindungsgemäß wird der Ladekreislauf zur weiteren Effizienzsteigerung in mehreren Stufen mit einer Verbindung zwischen einem jeweiligen Separator und dem zugehörigen Leitungsabschnitt versehen, wobei der Separator zwischen einer Drossel der nachfolgenden Stufe und einer zur Stufe zugehörigen Drossel angeordnet ist.

title: Speicheranlage mit Kühlkreislauf
docs.abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft eine Speicheranlage zum Speichern thermischer Energie mit einem Ladekreislauf, welcher in unmittelbarer oder mittelbarer Abfolge einen Verdampfer und einen Verdichter und einen mit einem Wärmespeicher gekoppelten Wärmetauscher und eine Drossel umfasst. Dazu wird der Ladekreislauf um einen Kühlkreislauf ergänzt. Dieser umfasst in unmittelbarer oder mittelbarer Abfolge den Verdichter und eine Kühlkreislaufdrossel und eine Mischvorrichtung, wobei über die Mischvorrichtung Wasser in den Kühlkreislauf eingebracht werden kann.

title: PUMPED HEAT ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEM WITH GENERATION CYCLE THERMAL INTEGRATION
docs.abstract: A first system herein may include: (i) a pumped-heat energy storage system ("PHES system"), wherein the PHES system is operable in a generation mode to convert at least a portion of stored thermal energy into electricity, wherein the PHES system includes a working fluid path circulating a working fluid through, in sequence, at least a compressor system, a hot-side heat exchanger system, a turbine system, a cold-side heat exchanger system, and back to the compressor system; and (ii) a fluid path directing a first fluid through an intercooler and to a power generation plant, and wherein the working fluid path through the compressor system includes circulating the working fluid through, in sequence, at least a first compressor, the intercooler, and a second compressor, and wherein the intercooler thermally contacts the working fluid with the first fluid, transferring heat from the working fluid to the first fluid.

title: PUMPED HEAT ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEM WITH GENERATION CYCLE THERMAL INTEGRATION
docs.abstract: In accordance with the present disclosure, a pumped-heat energy storage (“PHES”) system operable in charge and power generation modes can include a working fluid path circulating a working fluid through, in sequence, at least a compressor system, a hot-side heat exchanger system, a turbine system, a cold-side heat exchanger system, and back to the compressor system; and an intercooler system for providing cooling to the compressor system, the intercooling system including at least one intercooler heat exchanger arranged for transferring heat out from working fluid amid different stages of the compressor system to a power plant. A fluid path can be arranged for providing a power plant fluid to receive heat from the intercooler system. The fluid path can be arranged to pass the power plant fluid to the intercooler system to receive heat and to the power plant for use in heating in power generation.

title: USE OF EXTERNAL AIR FOR CLOSED CYCLE INVENTORY CONTROL
docs.abstract: Systems and methods relating to use of external air for inventory control of a closed thermodynamic cycle system or energy storage system, such as a reversible Brayton cycle system, are disclosed. A method may involve, in a closed cycle system operating in a power generation mode, circulating a working fluid may through a closed cycle fluid path. The closed cycle fluid path may include a high pressure leg and a low pressure leg. The method may further involve in response to a demand for increased power generation, compressing and dehumidifying environmental air. And the method may involve injecting the compressed and dehumidified environmental air into the low pressure leg.

title: SISTEMA DE ARMAZENAMENTO DE ENERGIA TÉRMICA BOMBEADA COM INTEGRAÇÃO TÉRMICA DE CICLO DE GERAÇÃO
docs.abstract: SISTEMA DE ARMAZENAMENTO DE ENERGIA TÉRMICA BOMBEADA COM INTEGRAÇÃO TÉRMICA DE CICLO DE GERAÇÃO. A presente invenção refere-se a sistema que compreende primeiro sistema que pode incluir: (i) um sistema de armazenamento de energia térmica bombeada ("sistema PHES"), em que o sistema PHES é operável em um modo de geração para converter pelo menos uma parte da energia térmica armazenada em eletricidade, em que o sistema PHES inclui um caminho de fluido de trabalho circulando um fluido de trabalho através, em sequência, de pelo menos um sistema de compressor, um sistema do trocador de calor lado-quente, um sistema de turbina, um sistema do trocador de calor lado-frio e de volta ao sistema de compressor; e (ii) um caminho de fluido direcionando um primeiro fluido através de um intercooler e para uma usina de geração de energia, e em que o caminho de fluido de trabalho através do sistema de compressor inclui a circulação do fluido de trabalho através, em sequência, de pelo menos um primeiro compressor, do intercooler, e um segundo compressor, e em que o intercooler contata termicamente o fluido de trabalho com o primeiro fluido, transferindo calor do fluido de trabalho para o primeiro fluido.

title: uso de ar externo para controle de inventário de ciclo fechado
docs.abstract: sistemas e métodos relacionados ao uso de ar externo para controle de estoque de um sistema fechado de ciclo termodinâmico ou sistema de armazenamento de energia, como um sistema de ciclo reversível de brayton, são divulgados. um método pode envolver, em um sistema de ciclo fechado operando em um modo de geração de energia, circulando um fluido de trabalho pode através de um caminho fluido ciclo fechado. o trajeto fluido do ciclo fechado pode incluir uma perna de alta pressão e uma perna de baixa pressão. o método pode envolver ainda mais em resposta a uma demanda de aumento da geração de energia, compressão e desumidificação do ar ambiental. e o método pode envolver injetando o ar ambiental comprimido e desumidificado no pé da baixa pressão.

docs.abstract: Systems and methods relating to use of external air for inventory control of a closed thermodynamic cycle system or energy storage system, such as a reversible Brayton cycle system, are disclosed. A method may involve, in a closed cycle system operating in a power generation mode, circulating a working fluid may through a closed cycle fluid path. title: PUMPED THERMAL STORAGE CYCLES WITH TURBOMACHINE SPEED CONTROL
docs.abstract: The present disclosure provides pumped thermal energy storage systems that can be used to store electrical energy. A pumped thermal energy storage system of the present disclosure can store energy by operating as a heat pump or refrigerator, whereby network input can be used to transfer heat from the cold side to the hot side. title: Pumped heat energy storage system with thermal plant integration
docs.abstract: La presente divulgación proporciona sistemas de almacenamiento de energía térmica por bombeo que pueden utilizarse para almacenar y/o extraer energía eléctrica. Un sistema de almacenamiento de energía térmica por bombeo de la presente divulgación puede almacenar energía operando como una bomba de calor, por lo que la entrada de trabajo neto se puede utilizar para transferir calor desde el lado frío al lado caliente. Un fluido de trabajo del sistema es capaz de intercambiar calor eficazmente con fluidos de almacenamiento de calor en un lado caliente del sistema y en un lado frío del sistema. Estos sistemas de acumulación de energía por bombeo pueden integrarse de forma beneficiosa con plantas térmicas para proporcionar transferencia de calor hacia y/o desde las plantas térmicas.

title: SISTEMA DE ARMAZENAMENTO DE ENERGIA TÉRMICA BOMBEADA COM INTEGRAÇÃO DE PLANTA TÉRMICA
docs.abstract: SISTEMA DE ARMAZENAMENTO DE ENERGIA TÉRMICA BOMBEADA COM INTEGRAÇÃO DE PLANTA TÉRMICA. A presente invenção refere-se a sistemas de armazenamento de energia térmica bombeada que podem ser usados para armazenar e /ou extrair energia elétrica. Um sistema de armazenamento de energia térmica bombeado da presente invenção pode armazenar energia operando como uma bomba de calor, em que a entrada de trabalho líquido pode ser usada para transferir calor do lado frio para o lado quente. Um fluido de trabalho do sistema é capaz de troca de calor eficiente com fluidos de armazenamento de calor em um lado quente do sistema e em um lado frio do sistema. Esses sistemas de armazenamento de energia bombeada podem ser integrados de forma benéfica com plantas térmicas para fornecer transferência de calor para e/ou às plantas térmicas.

A presente invenção refere-se a sistemas de armazenamento de energia térmica bombeada que podem ser usados para armazenar e obter energia elétrica. Um sistema de armazenamento de energia térmica bombeado da presente divulgação pode armazenar energia operando como uma bomba de calor, em que a entrada de trabalho fluido pode ser usada para transferir calor do lado frio para o lado quente. Um fluido de trabalho do sistema é capaz de troca de calor eficiente com fluidos de armazenamento de calor em um lado quente do sistema e em um lado frio do sistema. O sistema também pode obter energia operando como um motor térmico, transferindo calor do lado quente para o lado frio, o que pode resultar em saída de trabalho fluido. Trens de força compartilhados e trens de força reversíveis são divulgados para circular o fluido de trabalho.

title: PUMPED HEAT ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEM WITH ELECTRIC HEATING INTEGRATION
docs.abstract: A method including: (i) operating a pumped-heat energy storage system ("PHES system") in a charge mode to convert electricity into stored thermal energy in a hot thermal storage medium ("HTS medium") by transferring heat from a working fluid to a warm HTS medium, resulting in a hot HTS medium, wherein the PHES system is further operable in a generation mode to convert at least a portion of the stored thermal energy into electricity; and (ii) heating the hot HTS medium with an electric heater above a temperature achievable by transferring heat from the working fluid to the warm HTS medium.

title: ADIABATIC SALT ENERGY STORAGE
docs.abstract: Efficient energy storage is provided by using a working fluid flowing in a closed cycle including a ganged compressor and turbine, and capable of efficient heat exchange with heat storage fluids on a hot side of the system and on a cold side of the system. This system can operate as a heat engine by transferring heat from the hot side to the cold side to mechanically drive the turbine. The system can also operate as a refrigerator by mechanically driving the compressor to transfer heat from the cold side to the hot side. Heat exchange between the working fluid of the system and the heat storage fluids occurs in counter-flow heat exchangers. In a preferred approach, molten salt is the hot side heat storage fluid and water is the cold side heat storage fluid.

docs.abstract: A method including: (i) operating a pumped-heat energy storage system (“PHES system”) in a charge mode to convert electricity into stored thermal energy in a hot thermal storage medium (“HTS medium”) by transferring heat from a working fluid to a warm HTS medium, resulting in a hot HTS medium, wherein the PHES system is further operable in a generation mode to convert at least a portion of the stored thermal energy into electricity; and (ii) heating the hot HTS medium with an electric heater above a temperature achievable by transferring heat from the working fluid to the warm HTS medium.

title: VARIABLE PRESSURE TURBINE
docs.abstract: Systems and methods relating to variable pressure turbines are disclosed. A power generation system may include a closed cycle system configured to generate power, a combustor, and a control system. The closed cycle system may include a working fluid circulating in a closed cycle path. The combustor may provide thermal energy to the working fluid. Further, the control system may be configured to determine to increase an amount of power generated by the closed cycle system, and in response to the determination to increase the amount of power generated by the closed cycle system, cause an increase in pressure of the working fluid in the closed cycle path.

title: ADIABATIC SALT ENERGY STORAGE
docs.abstract: Efficient energy storage is provided by using a working fluid flowing in a closed cycle including a ganged compressor and turbine, and capable of efficient heat exchange with heat storage fluids on a hot side of the system and on a cold side of the system. This system can operate as a heat engine by transferring heat from the hot side to the cold side to mechanically drive the turbine. The system can also operate as a refrigerator by mechanically driving the compressor to transfer heat from the cold side to the hot side. Heat exchange between the working fluid of the system and the heat storage fluids occurs in counter-flow heat exchangers. In a preferred approach, molten salt is the hot side heat storage fluid and water is the cold side heat storage fluid.

title: PUMP CONTROL OF CLOSED CYCLE POWER GENERATION SYSTEM
docs.abstract: Disclosed are systems and methods for pump control of a closed thermodynamic cycle system, such as a Brayton cycle. Operational parameters such as working fluid temperature, thermal fluid temperature, stream pressure, and power generation may be the basis for controlling a thermal fluid pump rate.
